_comment: Per-title literal phrases from the open-vocabulary (Haiku) pass over the full crawler pool, assigned to families with the same title regexes the published CSV uses. 'families' = most distinctive (>=6% of the title's ads and >=1.8x elsewhere); 'counts' = every phrase seen in >=3 ads of that title, so a quoted example can state how many other ads say the same. Regenerate with sql/title-phrases.sql.
